accounting_rules.money: Ledger values authoritative for runs. OR usage.cost reconciliation; Anthropic configured runner rates (not an invoice). Codex null, never $0.
accounting_rules.anthropic_long_context: All cost components x5 when input_uncached + cache_read + cache_write >100000, matching run_study.cost.
accounting_rules.reasoning: Subset of output; Anthropic output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens corrected locally. Not added to output or billed a second time.
accounting_rules.cache_rate: Token weighted cache_read/input_total; also actual per-response any-hit and zero-read counts. Zero reads do not by themselves identify cache expiry or a cold cache.
accounting_rules.state_history: Measured JSON characters/bytes, not token estimates. Sums repeat prefixes and do not measure unique retained content.
accounting_rules.first_target_turn: Full observed input and first locally constructed request history, not invented memory-only overhead.
accounting_rules.timing: Model successful and failed request wall separated. Shell includes SQL/Python/process overhead. SQL CLI timings are a nested subset; do not add shell+SQL.
accounting_rules.coverage: CLI timer count is process invocations, not SQL statements; Python SQLite and killed/missing wrappers have partial coverage.
accounting_rules.causality: No action-category token pricing, causal overhead allocation or guaranteed cold-cache comparison.

first_target_turn.interpretation: Observed full input/context, not causal memory overhead; characters are not tokens.

att as (

cd /work; D=../data/current.db; B="$(cat base.sql)"; sqlite3 -header $D "$B SELECT period, class_code, count(*) ops, round(100.0*count(*)/SUM(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY period),4) traffic_pct, sum(tf) fails, round(100.0*sum(tf)/count(*),4) pct FROM opf GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;"; sqlite3 -header $D "$B , cell AS (SELECT period, region_code, class_code, build_code, count(*) n, sum(tf) f, 100.0*sum(tf)/count(*) p FROM opf GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) SELECT build_code, count(*) slices, round(avg(p),4) std_pct, sum(case when build_code='idx-r19' then 0 end) x FROM cell GROUP BY build_code;"; sqlite3 -header $D "$B , cell AS (SELECT period, region_code, class_code, build_code, count(*) n, sum(tf) f, 100.0*sum(tf)/count(*) p FROM opf GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) SELECT c.period,c.region_code,c.class_code, c.p cand, r.p ref, c.p-r.p diff FROM cell c JOIN cell r ON r.period=c.period AND r.region_code=c.region_code AND r.class_code=c.class_code AND r.build_code='idx-r18' WHERE c.build_code='idx-r19';"; sqlite3 -header $D "$B SELECT period, build_code, route_id, count(*) FROM logical_operations o JOIN opf USING(operation_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3" 2>&1 | head -5; sqlite3 -header $D "select count(distinct operation_id) from opf"

cd /data; cat /tmp/base.sql > /tmp/q2.sql; cat >> /tmp/q2.sql <<'EOF'
SELECT ops.period, ops.pool_code, ROUND(AVG(la.queue_ms),3) q_mean, ROUND(AVG(la.execution_ms),3) e_mean, COUNT(*) n
FROM ops JOIN att USING(operation_id)
JOIN attempt_events la ON la.operation_id=ops.operation_id AND la.attempt_no=att.last_no

 wp.pool_code, ts.signal_code, ts.unit, ROUND(AVG(value),4) mean_value, COUNT(*) n, MIN(measured_at_ms), MAX(measured_at_ms)
FROM telemetry_samples s JOIN worker_pools wp USING(pool_id) JOIN telemetry_signals ts USING(signal_id)

cd /data; cat > /tmp/ops.txt <<'EOF'
WITH ops AS (SELECT o.operation_id, o.opened_at_ms, wp.pool_code, p.deadline_ms, CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms >= 1778148000000 AND o.opened_at_ms < 1778151600000 THEN 'reference_10_11' WHEN o.opened_at_ms >= 1778151600000 AND o.opened_at_ms < 1778155200000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END AS period FROM logical_operations o JOIN service_routes r ON r.route_id=o.route_id JOIN services s ON s.service_id=r.service_id AND s.service_code='ledger-sync' JOIN route_assignments a ON a.route_id=o.route_id AND o.opened_at_ms>=a.effective_from_ms AND o.opened_at_ms<a.effective_to_ms JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=a.pool_id JOIN policy_profiles p ON p.profile_id=a.profile_id WHERE o.opened_at_ms >= 1778148000000 AND o.opened_at_ms < 1778155200000), att AS (SELECT ae.operation_id, COUNT(*) AS n_att, MAX(ae.attempt_no) AS last_no, SUM(fc.is_success=0) AS failed_att FROM attempt_events ae JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=ae.code_id GROUP BY ae.operation_id)
EOF
O=$(cat /tmp/ops.txt)
E1="$O SELECT ops.period, ops.pool_code, COUNT(*) AS operations, SUM(CASE WHEN fl.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminal_failures, SUM(att.n_att) AS attempts, SUM(att.failed_att) AS failed_attempts, SUM(att.n_att>1) AS retried_operations, MIN(ops.deadline_ms) AS min_deadline_ms, MAX(ops.deadline_ms) AS max_deadline_ms FROM ops JOIN att USING(operation_id) JOIN attempt_events la ON la.operation_id=ops.operation_id AND la.attempt_no=att.last_no JOIN failure_codes fl ON fl.code_id=la.code_id WHERE ops.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ops.period, ops.pool_code ORDER BY ops.period, ops.pool_code;"
E2="$O SELECT ops.period, ops.pool_code, AVG(la.queue_ms) AS failed_terminal_queue_mean_ms, AVG(la.execution_ms) AS failed_terminal_execution_mean_ms, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ops JOIN att USING(operation_id) JOIN attempt_events la ON la.operation_id=ops.operation_id AND la.attempt_no=att.last_no JOIN failure_codes fl ON fl.code_id=la.code_id AND fl.is_success=0 WHERE ops.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ops.period, ops.pool_code ORDER BY ops.period, ops.pool_code;"
E3="SELECT CASE WHEN s.measured_at_ms >= 1778148000000 AND s.measured_at_ms < 1778151600000 THEN 'reference_10_11' WHEN s.measured_at_ms >= 1778151600000 AND s.measured_at_ms < 1778155200000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END AS period, wp.pool_code, ts.signal_code, ts.unit, AVG(s.value) AS mean_value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telemetry_samples s JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=s.pool_id JOIN telemetry_signals ts ON ts.signal_id=s.signal_id WHERE wp.pool_code IN ('sync-north','sync-south') AND s.measured_at_ms >= 1778148000000 AND s.measured_at_ms < 1778155200000 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3;"
E4="SELECT ce.change_id, ce.effective_at_ms, ck.kind_code, wp.pool_code, ce.before_json, ce.after_json FROM change_events ce JOIN change_kinds ck ON ck.kind_id=ce.kind_id LEFT JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=ce.pool_id WHERE ce.effective_at_ms >= 1778148000000 AND ce.effective_at_ms < 1778155200000 ORDER BY ce.effective_at_ms;"
E5="$O SELECT ops.period, ops.pool_code, fl.code, COUNT(*) AS final_outcomes FROM ops JOIN att USING(operation_id) JOIN attempt_events la ON la.operation_id=ops.operation_id AND la.attempt_no=att.last_no JOIN failure_codes fl ON fl.code_id=la.code_id WHERE ops.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;"
for q in "$E1" "$E2" "$E3" "$E4" "$E5"; do sqlite3 -header current.db "$q"; echo ---; done
printf '%s\n' "$E1" "$E2" "$E3" "$E4" "$E5" > /tmp/evidence.txt
